name: DECISION: IT team column names do not match the standing order (To Do / Doing vs Scheduled / Working)
description:
PROBLEM (recurring, 3 shifts in a row)
The standing order for every software_developer shift says: "Take the first card in **To Do** on the **IT team** board, move it to **Doing**, … then move it to **Review**." Two of those three column names do not exist on the board, so the order cannot be executed literally and every shift has to improvise.

MEASURED STATE (verified 2026-11-18)
- `IT team` columns: `Inbox`, `Scheduled`, `Working`, `Done`, `Review` (`Review` was added by software_developer in shift #2 for exactly this reason; board file `.codx/tasks/boards/0dbd227e-2898-45e8-b582-c5f5b879a597/board.json`).
- Canonical task states available to every board: `todo`, `doing`, `onhold`, `done`, `rejected` — these DO match "To Do / Doing", only the column titles differ.
- Working mapping used so far: `Scheduled ≈ To Do` (queue, `status=todo`), `Working ≈ Doing` (`status=doing`), `Review` (`status=onhold`, never closed by the agent) — applied successfully on card `29dfe331`.
- The sibling actor boards (`Agent: qa`, `Agent: ProjectManager`, `Agent: ciso`, `Agent: software_developer`) use the same `Inbox/Scheduled/Working/Done` titles, so renaming `IT team` alone would desynchronise the family.

THE DECISION NEEDED (pick one, then record it)
A. Keep the current titles and record the mapping `Scheduled → Working → Review` as the canonical interpretation of the standing order (zero migration risk; recommended if the AI boards stay as they are).
B. Rename `IT team` columns to `To Do / Doing / Review / Done` so the order is literal (moves the folder of every card in those columns; must not be done while cards are in flight).
C. Create `To Do` and `Doing` as ADDITIONAL columns next to `Scheduled`/`Working` (not recommended — two columns with the same meaning; the next shift would not know which one to pick).
D. Rewrite the standing order to name the real columns.

WHY IT MATTERS
Ambiguity here is what made shifts #1 and #2 report "board is empty / nothing in To Do" and skip the work. Card `29dfe331` was only picked because a shift ignored the literal wording.

ACCEPTANCE
One of A–D is chosen, written into the board description (or into the standing order text, for D), and the next shift can follow it without inventing a mapping.
DO NOT: rename or delete columns while cards sit in them; do not touch cards owned by other actors.
